pairs.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/standards_scan.rs:314 run_standards_scan builds its own spawn from headless_claude_args instead of going through the spawn_headless_claude door, and never calls force_subscription_auth. A metered Anthropic key in the app env therefore bills every standards scan, and the scan runs with skip-permissions in the project root: a scanner with an editor's stance.

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/standards_scan.rs:329 Only the env_removals from build_cli_args are applied (CLAUDECODE / DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING*), with no ANTHROPIC_* key. Compare cli_process.rs:516, where the shared door bakes the strip in. The strip lives at the call site, and this call site forgot it.

src-tauri/engine/src/prompt/cli_args.rs:107 The standards scan is a readonly-scan by purpose. It inherits the full-bypass flag through headless_claude_args and runs with current_dir set to the repo root, with no plan mode, tool allowlist or write denylist.

src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/standards_scan.rs:69 NDJSON lines go through a typed envelope (FindingEnvelope), and non-envelope lines are skipped. That is a partial realization: I did not check how in-envelope error subtypes are handled.

pairs.evidence: src/hooks/utility/data/useCliReadiness.ts:40 Every probe failure that is not a missing binary (init timeout, EOF, a non-init transcript) collapses into 'no_session', so an unknown probe result renders as a confident 'sign in'. The status vocabulary has no unknown value at all.

techniques.evidence: src/hooks/utility/data/useCliReadiness.ts:5 Installed and authorized are split (good), but the result has no unknown state. Line 40 maps unclassified failures to unauthorized, against unknown-is-not-a-value.

src/hooks/utility/data/useEngineCapabilities.ts:71 Installed-ness for operation gating comes from healthCheckLocal's claude_cli item, which tries candidate names in health.rs, not from the spawn-path probe that useCliReadiness uses (probeCliCapabilities, line 62). These are two predicates for one fact, so the shell gate and the operation gate can disagree.
